summary: No ship: the new production expression can suppress genuine swapless tmpfs/shared-memory pressure, while the regression gate does not preserve the required alert boundary.

facts.relaunchTail: This is a property of the run, not of the repository, so the round's next launch may use another backend (--reviewer claude) — the caller performs that switch as its second launch; this launcher never spawns a second backend itself.

triage: review-gate SKILL.md §§ Triage and Rounds govern. Render EVERY finding as a full table row — `ID | Finding (title + full body) | Severity | file:line | Code | Recommendation | Proposed decision` — never truncated and never inside a dialog; then ask the ROUND before the rows — take every Proposed decision as it stands, or decide row by row — and `as proposed` ends the round in that ONE action; only if row-by-row was chosen, ask per finding with that row's Proposed decision as the first option, a reject or defer taking a free-text reason; echo back ONLY the rows that carried free text, and none if the round was decided by selection alone. Max 2 rounds. Append the decided rows to `docs/reviews/<slug>/decisions.md` under a `### <gate> r<n> (<reviewer>)` heading — one line per row, `<ID> <decision> — <finding title>[; <reason for reject/defer>]`, and an accepted waiver as `WAIVED by user: <reason>` — then COMMIT it with this artifact. That grammar is not decoration: the conductors anchor on `^### <gate> r<n>` and read the waiver line as the pass condition, so a ledger written in any other shape reads back as a gate still owed.

findings.title: Subtracting total cache hides unreclaimable tmpfs/shared memory
findings.body: `container_memory_cache` is cgroup-v2 `memory.stat:file`, which includes tmpfs and shared memory—not only clean reclaimable page cache ([Linux documentation](https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/cgroup-v2.html)). This host explicitly disables swap (`infra/k3s-bootstrap/host-config.sh:183-187`), so live tmpfs/shmem pages cannot be swapped out, yet the new expression subtracts them entirely for every non-system container. A container consuming 94% of its limit through shared memory can consequently evaluate near 0%, suppressing the only leading alert until `PodOOMKilled`. L2 uses only 2Mi of cache and does not exercise this regression.
findings.code:
- alert: ContainerMemoryNearLimit
            expr: |
              (max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_usage_bytes{container!="", namespace!~"kube-system|kube-public|kube-node-lease"})
                - max by (namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_cache{container!="", namespace!~"kube-system|kube-public|kube-node-lease"}))
                / max by (namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{resource="memory"})
                > 0.85
            for: 10m
            labels: { severity: warning }
            annotations:
              summary: "컨테이너 메모리 limit 근접: {{ $labels.namespace }}/{{ $labels.pod }}/{{ $labels.container }}"
              description: "회수 불가 메모리(anon+slab — page cache 제외)가 메모리 limit의 85%를 10분 초과 — OOM 임박. 메모리 원장에서 해당 행 limit 상향을 검토하세요."
findings.recommendation: Choose a numerator that retains swapless tmpfs/shmem and subtracts only demonstrably reclaimable file cache, or use an appropriate pressure/event signal. Add a replay leg where tmpfs/shmem alone exceeds 85% and must fire, while preserving the clean-cache glances negative case.

findings.title: The regression gate permits the supposedly unchanged threshold and duration to drift
findings.body: The diagnosis requires `0.85` and `for: 10m` to remain unchanged, but the gate accepts any threshold from 0.70 through 0.95 and scales its replay window to whatever duration it reads. Its claimed 90% L2 fixture is actually 95.3125% (`vmalert-memory-nearlimit-gen.py:47-49`), so changing the production threshold to 0.95 or lengthening `for:` still passes. The evidence therefore does not enforce the bugfix's single-flip contract.
findings.code:
FOR="$(vme_alert_for "$VME_RULES" "$ALERT")"
[ -n "$FOR" ] || fault "$ALERT: for: 부재(무매치 또는 키 없음) — 발화 경계를 판정할 수 없다"
FOR_S="$(vme_to_s "$FOR")"

# 임계는 **룰에서 파생**한다(하드코딩하면 룰이 바뀔 때 하네스가 조용히 낡는다).
T="$(grep -oE '>[[:space:]]*0\.[0-9]+' <<<"$EXPR" | head -1 | grep -oE '0\.[0-9]+' || true)"
[ -n "$T" ] || fault "$ALERT: 임계 상수 추출 실패 — expr에서 '> 0.NN' 형태를 찾지 못했다"

# 임계 제정신 검사 — 파생한 임계로 픽스처까지 판정하므로 상·하한이 없으면 하네스가 자기충족적이다.
# (임계를 0.999로 부풀려도 L1은 그대로 통과한다 — 형제 adguard 하네스가 mutation으로 실증한 함정.)
awk -v t="$T" 'BEGIN{exit !(t >= 0.70 && t <= 0.95)}' \
  || contract "$ALERT 임계 $T 가 [0.70, 0.95] 밖 — 너무 낮으면 만성 오탐, 너무 높으면 OOM 전에 못 운다."

# ── 2) preflight: 픽스처가 두 판정을 실제로 가르는지 **기계가** 강제한다 ─────────────────────────────
# replay 창: for:를 넘겨야 발화가 관측된다. for의 3배 + 룩백 여유.
SPAN_S=$(( FOR_S * 3 + VME_LOOKBACK_S ))
findings.recommendation: Assert `T == 0.85` and `FOR == 10m`, and construct L2 at approximately 90% so loss of the intended leading margin fails.

findings.title: The load-bearing gate oracle bypasses the repository's typed-code boundary
findings.body: `CONTRIBUTING.md:26-38` explicitly forbids embedding Python in shell and assigns structured parsing, calculation, and artifact generation to typed `tools/*.ts` code. This heredoc computes the preflight oracle deciding whether L1/L2 are meaningful; the separate new Python generator crosses the same boundary. Neither receives the mandated `bun run typecheck` and focused-test coverage, so an oracle defect can make the expensive replay evidence falsely green.
findings.code:
ratios() { # $1=container 라벨 → "ws_ratio nonrecl_ratio"
  python3 - "$FIXTURE" "$1" <<'PY'
import json, sys
path, want = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
v = {}
for line in open(path):
    o = json.loads(line)
    m = o["metric"]
    if m.get("container") == want:
        v[m["__name__"]] = float(o["values"][0])
need = ["container_memory_working_set_bytes", "container_memory_usage_bytes",
        "container_memory_cache", "kube_pod_container_resource_limits"]
missing = [n for n in need if n not in v]
if missing:
    sys.exit("픽스처에 %s의 메트릭 누락: %s" % (want, ",".join(missing)))
ws, us, ca, li = (v[n] for n in need)
if not (ws <= us and ca <= us and li > 0):
    sys.exit("픽스처 %s 물리 정합성 위반: ws=%d us=%d ca=%d li=%d" % (want, ws, us, ca, li))
print("%.6f %.6f" % (ws / li, (us - ca) / li))
PY
}
findings.recommendation: Move fixture generation and ratio validation into a tested `tools/*.ts` command and leave the shell harness as orchestration only.

next_steps: Correct the production metric semantics and add a swapless tmpfs/shmem true-positive replay case.
Pin the exact 0.85/10m contract and use the specified 90% positive fixture.
Move structured test-oracle logic to typed tooling, then rerun the replay and repository gates in a writable environment.
